Question: Four friends do yardwork for their neighbors over the weekend, earning \(\$15,\) \(\$20,\) \(\$25,\) and \(\$40\) respectively. They decide to split their earnings equally among themselves. In total how much will the friend who earned \(\$40\) give to the others?
